name: CUMCM 2024 B policy-scope regression
purpose: Ensure the workflow does not confuse a restricted fixed-policy enumeration with a globally optimal feedback policy.

checks.requirement: OPTIMALITY_SCOPE.md identifies the enumerated policy class.
A global-optimality claim requires a feedback-policy formulation or an explicit proof that feedback cannot improve the result.
Executed dynamic and fixed-policy outputs remain separate and traceable.
